summary: Iteration 12: Tested Commercial Billing (Accounts->PM->Owner->Paid), Vehicles/Drivers/Trips, per-module Permissions (levels + fine-tune), Members/Team search, mobile project dropdown menu, Residential Quotations (revisions, client e-sign, request changes/reject, PDF), Drawings (architect/structural upload, approval, supersede, client visibility), Design dashboard, role-creation guards, regression (login, super admin, DPR). Backend 17/17 new pytest tests pass (plus iter11 suite 25/25 when run serially; iter9/10 pass). All requested frontend flows work end-to-end. Only minor UX/code-review items found.

minor.issue: Resubmit does not re-run the vendor+bill_no duplicate check, so a rejected bill can be edited into a duplicate of another bill (POST correctly returns 409).
The update has no status guard ({id, status:'approved'}), so two concurrent requests can both mark a bill paid and append two history entries. decide_bill already guards this.

Any project member (architect, structural engineer, site engineer) can list every quotation with pricing and client responses (only the client is filtered). Confirm this is intended; if not, limit it to managers + client.

Adding an existing project engineer (in engineer_ids) as a member replaces their ENGINEER_DEFAULT permissions with the dialog default (dpr:view, attendance:create). They silently lose DPR create/submit and vehicle-request rights. Consider pre-filling the dialog with current effective perms.

issues: Reject uses the native window.prompt for remarks, which doesn't match the shadcn Dialog used for bill reject.
'Valid until' uses the browser's native date input instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover
Line-item row inputs (unit/qty/rate) have no column labels; only placeholders/values show
Agree checkbox is a native <input type=checkbox> instead of the shadcn Checkbox used elsewhere
Bill date, due date and trip date use native date inputs (not the shadcn calendar)
Employee picker lists Owner/PM (who already have full access) and existing members
Default attendance:['create'] shows as 'Custom' level, which may confuse users
Requests are sorted by trip_date desc only, so open 'requested' items aren't pinned on top

action_items: (Optional) Add the duplicate vendor+bill_no check in PUT /bills/{bid} (exclude the bill itself)
(Optional) Add a status:'approved' filter to the mark_paid update_one and return 409 if not modified
Decide whether non-manager members (architect/structural/engineer) should see quotation pricing; restrict if not
Pre-fill the member permission dialog with the engineer's effective default perms so adding an engineer as a member doesn't downgrade them
Replace window.prompt in the DrawingsTab reject with a Dialog + Textarea; swap the native date inputs/checkbox for shadcn components
critical_code_review_comments: commercial.py is 815 lines (>700): consider splitting members/permissions out
billing.py: mark_paid has a race (no status filter on the update)
quotations.py: _quote hides draft-only quotes from clients via 404 (good). PDF for a client is limited to sent revisions (verified).
get_project_or_403 gives the accounts role access to every company project by design; confirm that is the business intent

success_rate.backend: 100% (17/17 new; regression suites pass when run serially)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_/UI_ prefixed bills (BILL-00002..00008), vehicles MH01*/MH02*/MH04UI1636 (TEST Innova/Bolero/UI Tata Ace), vehicle requests in 2027 dates, quotations QT-CH-001-002..006 (UI_QUOTE Wardrobes accepted by 'Sunita Joshi'), drawings A-1215EB (R1 superseded/R2 approved), A-C3C234 (rejected), A-UI607 (approved), S-1215EB (rejected), S-C3C234. Temp member user-eng2 removed. reset_superadmin.py run; login_attempts cleared.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use test_billing_vehicles_quotes_iter12.py for regression (uses a random UID and a random 2027 trip date to avoid clashes). Note: in browser automation, a second full page.goto() in the same session sometimes triggers an Emergent 'Part of the app failed to load src/index.js' overlay, so use one login per script and navigate via nav links. Running the iter11 superadmin suite in parallel with other suites (xdist) causes 2 flaky failures (tenant suspend/expire state); run it with -n0.
rca of the issue: No blocking bugs. Flaky iter11 failures come from cross-suite parallel interference (suspend/expire of shared tenants), not a product bug.
